editorial.blurb: This takeout-only Chinese-American spot in the South Loop has become a social media sensation for their crispy fried chicken sandwiches and char siu BBQ pork, best enjoyed fresh at home.
editorial.insiderTip: Order online the night before for your preferred 30-minute pickup slot starting at 9:30pm, and eat immediately when you get home to maximize crispiness—bring your own napkins and utensils if eating outside.
